name: Mien luon
summary: Glass noodles in a broth simmered from eel bones, topped with small eels cooked in seasoning and eaten with shredded banana flower.
howToEat: Eat it with banana flower cut in threads.
seoTitle: Mien luon in Ninh Binh — eel bone broth
seoDescription: Ninh Bình miến lươn: eel-bone broth, glass noodles, seasoned eel, and shredded banana flower.
